page.overview:
What is Pawmi?

Pawmi is a chubby, quadrupedal rodent-like Pokémon that possesses orange fur and yellow electric sacs on its cheeks like all other Pikachu-family Pokémon. It has cream colored fur around its mouth, on its tail and on its hands, and has two long, yet rounded ears and a tuft of fur between them.

Pawmi has electric sacs on its cheeks and front paws. If threatened, it will run its cheeks and then touch its opponent with the sacs on its front paws to shock them.

It evolves into Pawmo starting at level 18 and then evolves into Pawmot if leveled up while outside of its Poké Ball after walking 1000 steps using the Let's Go feature.

Pawmi appears to be based on a mouse, specifically the due to its orange coat and distribution throughout European and Asian regions. It also has elements of marmots like its two evolutions.
